Several orders can be open on the same table (separate checks): they show as tabs at the top; **+** starts another one. "}},{"node":"markdown102","element":"markdown","data":{"label":"Add items","key":"md_add_items","id":"add-items","name":"md_add_items","value":"# Add items - The **catalog** shows the items of the room's menu, by item group. Use the search, the dietary filters, or the group list. - Tap an item to add it. If it has options (cooking point, sides, sizes, a combo's parts), a dialog asks for them first; required choices must be made before adding. - Tap a line to select it. Then change its **Qty**, **Disc%** or **Rate** with the keypad, edit its **Options**, add a **Note** for the kitchen, or delete it. Discounts above the role's limit and price changes ask for a manager's PIN. - New lines show as **new** until they are sent; until then they can be changed freely."}},{"node":"markdown103","element":"markdown","data":{"label":"Send to the kitchen","key":"md_send_to_the_kitchen","id":"send-to-the-kitchen","name":"md_send_to_the_kitchen","value":"# Send to the kitchen **Send** sends the new lines to their production centers (and prints their tickets). Each line then shows its status live: *Waiting*, *Processing*, *Ready*… Add more items any time and **Send** again: each send is a new round. **Courses: hold and fire.** Select lines and tap **Hold** to keep them back (for example the mains while the starters go out). **Send** sends everything else; when it's time, **Fire** sends the held lines. **Unhold** releases a line."}},{"node":"markdown104","element":"markdown","data":{"label":"On the order","key":"md_on_the_order","id":"on-the-order","name":"md_on_the_order","value":"# On the order - **Guests**: the number of guests (for reports and splitting). - **Notes**: a note for the whole order. - **Customer**: tap the customer at the top to change it, for example to a loyalty member. - **Transfer**: moves the whole order to another table. - **Divide**: choose how many of each item go to a new order on the same table (separate checks). - **Void**: removes a line or the whole order. Lines already sent ask for a **reason** (and a manager's PIN if the role can't void them); the kitchen sees the void on its screen and, with a printer, gets a VOID ticket. - **Bill**: prints the check for the guests. - **Pay**: opens the payment screen. See [Bills and payments](/Docs/Paying)."}},{"node":"markdown105","element":"markdown","data":{"label":"Whose table is it","key":"md_whose_table_is_it","id":"whose-table-is-it","name":"md_whose_table_is_it","value":"# Whose table is it With the restaurant's **Own tables** policy, a table with an open order belongs to the person who opened it. Others need *Work on other people's orders* or a manager's PIN to change it. Orders placed by guests (online, QR) belong to everyone. See [Restaurant](/Docs/Restaurant#table-service)."}},{"node":"markdown106","element":"markdown","data":{"label":"Before you start","key":"md_before_you_start","id":"before-you-start","name":"md_before_you_start","value":"# Before you start - If your restaurant requires it, **Clock in** from the staff menu (person icon, top right). - If you charge, open your **cash register** first. See [Cash register](/Docs/Cash%20Register)."}}]}]
